content: Hi..:) Browsing the web the past week I did uncover a little baby ultrasound resouce. Over at http://www.baby-ultrasound.com lots of info and a few pictures.

author: Tony Meyer
content: Thanks for the link! The prices they quote for 3D/"4D" scans are pretty steep (maybe the page is out of date a bit?) - they have $250 (US$, I presume) for a "4D" scan, whereas it's just under NZ$100 (~US$65) here.

content: hi i was woundering if theres any 3D ultrasound places in nz,Auckland

author: Tony Meyer
content: Insight Radiology on the North Shore does them (that's where we have done all of ours). They're just across from North Shore Hospital. Friends of ours got one done somewhere else (central city, maybe?) but I don't know where exactly.
